---
title: "NYC Weather Dashboard"
author: "Ruoqi Wang"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(lubridate)

data("ny_noaa")

weather_df =
  ny_noaa |>
  filter(
    id == "USW00094728",
    date >= as.Date("2010-01-01"),
    date <= as.Date("2015-12-31")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    month = month(date),
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Summer",
      TRUE ~ "Fall"
    ),
    season = factor(
      season,
      levels = c("Winter", "Spring",
                 "Summer", "Fall")
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(tmax), !is.na(tmin))

monthly_df =
  weather_df |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(
    avg_tmax = mean(tmax),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Column {data-width=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Average Monthly Maximum Temperature

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = monthly_df,
  x = ~month,
  y = ~avg_tmax,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Month",
      tickmode = "array",
      tickvals = 1:12,
      ticktext = month.abb
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Average Maximum Temperature (°C)"
    )
  )
```

### Maximum vs Minimum Temperature

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = weather_df,
  x = ~tmax,
  y = ~tmin,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  color = ~season,
  marker = list(opacity = 0.5)
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Maximum Temperature (°C)"
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Minimum Temperature (°C)"
    )
  )
```

Column {data-width=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Maximum Temperature by Season

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = weather_df,
  x = ~season,
  y = ~tmax,
  type = "box",
  color = ~season
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Season"),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Maximum Temperature (°C)"
    ),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```
